operator_source_descriptions.INT-02:entropy-difference-beta-update: Eq. 8 updates state-conditioned mixing weight beta from relative entropy of the two action distributions.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-02:cl-dpefe-geometric-policy-pool: Eq. 9 multiplicatively pools counterfactual-learning and DPEFE action distributions; the printed equation omits an explicit normalizer while separately released historical author code applies softmax.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-02:conditional-logistic-beta-derivat: Eq. 16 yields logistic beta only under the stated derivation conditions; Eq. 8 is a local approximation for small entropy differences.

unresolved_direct_ancestry: The paper explicitly inherits prior Paul et al. DPEFE and Isomura/Friston counterfactual-learning models, but W4 does not promote author-name/reference-number mentions to DOI ancestry without exact source-pinned DOI resolution.
adverse_source_limits: Printed Eq. 9 lacks an explicit normalization symbol; do not infer an implementation bug.
Historical author code is separate from the publisher VoR and was not numerically re-executed in W4.
Eq. 8 and Eq. 16 are not globally identical.
Task-specific simulation performance does not establish universal RL superiority.
No independent human causal fit or global family independence is established.
Exhaustive post-publication correction absence is not attested.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-03:reward-modulated-hebbian-workspac: Reward-modulated Hebbian synaptic update with bounded weights in the simulated workspace.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-03:reward-conditioned-vigilance-shor: Reward-conditioned vigilance and short-term weight multiplier alter subsequent routing/activation.

profiles.source_scope: Frozen PLOS publisher PDF identity from G2 plus current first-party article HTML used in W4 to recover source-native definitions; external code ZIP is not treated as the article edition.
profiles.computational_state: Drift-diffusion accumulated evidence z together with current action position relative to two targets; environment/body trajectory remain distinct from the computational variables.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-05:drift-diffusion-evidence-update: The decision layer accumulates sensory evidence in a diffusion-to-bound process shared across compared variants.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-05:evidence-conditioned-action-focus: Action preparation maps ongoing accumulated evidence to an intermediate focus between targets; choice terminates by action completion in parallel/embodied variants.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-05:position-feedback-commitment: The embodied variant adds a position-dependent distance term to accumulated information, creating explicit action-to-decision feedback and commitment.

unresolved_direct_ancestry: Diffusion-to-bound, continuous-flow and change-of-mind precedents are discussed, but conceptual/reference similarity is not promoted to a direct DOI ancestry edge.
adverse_source_limits: Physical embodiment itself is not promoted as a computational operator; only formal evidence, action-focus and feedback terms are profiled.
Action dynamics are simplified and richer biomechanics/action costs are outside the presented formalism.
No direct DOI genealogy edge is asserted from generic diffusion/continuous-flow terminology.
External code is a separate artifact, not silently equated with the publisher article.

profiles.source_scope: Publisher main article plus all eight official supplementary media physically frozen in G2-D; source-native family comparison to INT-03 remains bounded.
profiles.computational_state: Spiking sensory/task-set/router populations with accumulated evidence, task-set gating state and buffered peripheral sensory activity.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-06:taskset-nmda-spiking-router: Task-set populations gate routing through an NMDA-mediated spiking router rather than an abstract unbounded global workspace.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-06:evidence-threshold-response-gate: Routed sensory evidence accumulates to a response threshold/action gate.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-06:inhibitory-router-reset: Control-network inhibition/reset limits serial central routing after response selection.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-06:parallel-sensory-buffer: Peripheral sensory processing/buffering can proceed in parallel while the central router produces the dual-task serial bottleneck.

model_variants: router populations limited to experiment-relevant tasks
unresolved_direct_ancestry: Source records broad workspace/recurrent ancestry and pre-existing sensory-attractor, threshold/BG-inspired action-gating and rule-gated router motifs, but no exact DOI-level direct ancestor set is pinned.
The INT-03 relation is broad ancestry with a distinct task-set/NMDA router implementation; exact same central mathematical model is not demonstrated.
adverse_source_limits: Unmodeled irrelevant router populations are folded into background; do not infer an unbounded task repertoire.
Task-order-network ablation retains a typical PRP effect.
Some supplementary RT conditions are null and table alignment is not fully visually qualified.
All supplementary raw media are frozen, but every pixel-level scientific semantic is not exhaustively certified.
Shared broad workspace ancestry with INT-03 is neither exact model identity nor global independence.

profiles.source_scope: Main publisher PDF identity is frozen and first-party HTML exposes core state-space equations, but four model-defining Text S1-S4 PDFs are not raw-frozen in current repository evidence; W4 fails closed as SOURCE_BLOCKED.
profiles.computational_state: Continuous hidden state (allocentric location, speed, direction), control inputs, and modality-specific sensory observations in a nonlinear state-space generative model; environment-generated signals remain distinct from the agent observation model.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:state-transition-observation-mode: Separate dynamical transition and observation mappings define a nonlinear state-space generative model over hidden state, controls and sensory observations.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:ekf-forward-filter: Local-linearisation forward inference uses EKF prediction/correction and Kalman gain to combine path integration with sensory evidence.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:rts-gamma-backward-smoother: Retrospective backward inference uses gamma recursions; in the LDS case this is the RTS smoother. Beta recursions are an alternative requiring stored data.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-07:augmented-state-control-inference: Unknown control inputs are inferred via an augmented state-space model using forward/backward inference to obtain state trajectories and controls consistent with sensory goals.

unresolved_direct_ancestry: The source places the algorithms in the broad KF/EKF/RTS/state-space literature and cites earlier localisation/context models, but W4 does not collapse generic Bayesian/state-space machinery into a direct DOI model-family ancestry edge.
